preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 1000, inclusive.
The number of red, green, blue potions, and the number of minutes are each between 1 and 100, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: 1 <= r[i] <= 10^9 for all i in [0, R)
preconditions.description: Each red potion has a liquid amount between 1 and 10^9, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: 1 <= g[i] <= 10^9 for all i in [0, G)
preconditions.description: Each green potion has a liquid amount between 1 and 10^9, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: 1 <= b[i] <= 10^9 for all i in [0, B)
preconditions.description: Each blue potion has a liquid amount between 1 and 10^9, inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output is a single integer representing the minimum possible maximum amount of liquid among all potions after performing at most M magic tricks.
